notes.title: Battery Hunter - v1.0.19 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where monsters would attack the player's old position upon entering the next level.
[*] Fixed the problem with not being able to use the controller in the game (overridden by "Steam Input").
[*] Added new icons for Twitter and a button for the Facebook fan page.
[/list]
